{{Quote|I am also an excellent blender, toaster oven, and bang-corn air-popper, and can whip up an extraordinary meal from everyday garbage.|C2-R4|<ref name="TBT" />}}
A '''blender''' was a device that was used to prepare [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for consumption.<ref name="TBT" /> The [[C2-R4 Multipurpose Unit]] incorporated a toaster oven into its design, along with many other features.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
